value.rationale: An exact nonparametric identification theorem answers a natural inaccessible idle-clock inference problem. One-time stationary laws erase the duration shape, while full stationary covariance recovers it. The isolated universal crossing plus strict deterministic/exponential sign reversal supplies useful exact spectral consistency boundaries; complete-reset \(a=0\) precisely destroys identifiability.
